harnessCategories.array_in: Array input (optionally + scalar params); result printed by harness.

harnessCategories.grid_in: 2-D grid input; result printed by harness.
harnessCategories.linked_list_in: Harness builds a linked list from UI values; user function receives head.
harnessCategories.graph_in: Harness passes (n, edges[, start]); edges are [u,v] or [u,v,w] rows, nodes 0..n-1.
harnessCategories.stateful_class: Harness replays the full UI operation history against a fresh instance each run.
